vitest.command: npm exec --offline -- vitest run tests/unit/catalog-topics.test.ts tests/unit/content.test.ts tests/unit/content-answer-notes.test.ts tests/unit/catalog-full.test.ts --reporter=json

assertions.title: contains every approved topic, its target question count and a review of the current bytes
keeps every present package valid and globally unique
keeps stable answer ids, correctIndex and notes through JSON round-trip
loads legacy string answers without inventing a note
reports empty, oversized and HTML notes with answer paths
rejects generic placeholder notes
rejects a distractor-prefixed negative placeholder
rejects a broad category label that does not describe the distractor
rejects search, home and chapter-introduction sources
rejects answer-prefixed copies of one common explanation
requires four distinct notes in final packs but permits legacy migration strings
accepts the exact manifest catalog
reports a path for invalid answers and quotas
rejects duplicate prompt text across different topics
moves compact history with a question when its difficulty changes
draws a complete unique cycle and changes the next cycle boundary
keeps excluded questions in the remaining bag
is reproducible for the same seed and avoids a fixed order for another seed
maximizes distinct domains for normal, bonus, and final topic sets
diagnoses too few groups instead of repeating one in a normal set

previousHashBindingFailure: The pre-report receipts retain the baseline report hash mismatch. The bound final report passes catalog-full on the final topic bytes.
